name: WorkOS
summary: WorkOS sells enterprise auth building blocks (AuthKit, SSO, Directory Sync, Audit Logs, fine-grained authorization). For agents it can act as the OAuth authorization server for MCP servers, and in October 2026 it previewed Airlock, a policy layer that approves, denies or escalates agent actions.
facts: AuthKit, SSO, Directory Sync, Audit Logs, FGA, Radar, Pipes
AuthKit as authorization server; CIMD and DCR supported
AuthKit free to 1M MAU; SSO from $125 per connection/month
Hosted WorkOS MCP for managing the account (July 2026)
goodFor: B2B apps adding MCP servers that enterprises can SSO into
Teams that want SSO, SCIM and audit logs from one vendor
watchOut: Airlock, Atlas and Passport are previews
Per-connection SSO pricing adds up with many enterprise customers
